name: short_ref / resolve / fold_ref

test_list.description: The short ref of a stored blob is the 12-hex prefix of its Cid.
Two blobs sharing a 12-hex prefix make resolve return Ambiguous.
resolve of an unused prefix is UnknownShortRef.
short_ref_checked reports ShortRefCollision when another blob shares the prefix.
fold_ref writes exactly the 18 bytes of `§ref:<12hex>`.

output_description: Short references for §ref folding with collision detection.
